## Featured Government & Enterprise Work

- **PGEMP — Political Governance, Constituency & Election Management Platform**: Full-stack Nepal civic governance & election intelligence platform built with ASP.NET Core Clean Architecture (`PGEMP.API`, `PGEMP.Application`, `PGEMP.Domain`, `PGEMP.Infrastructure`), 13 SQL migrations, Docker/Nginx, and a React + TypeScript + Vite frontend with GIS ward mapping, voter/household CRM, booth & election management, volunteer field ops, governance monitoring, finance reconciliation, media radar, AI War Room Copilot, and RBAC.
- **BICCI (ICCI) — Birgunj Chamber of Commerce & Industries Website & CMS**: Designed and built the custom Content Management System (CMS) and public web portal for Nepal institutional & chamber operations using React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and ASP.NET Core.
- **Pivotal ERP (Currently Working On)**: IRD-approved enterprise cloud ERP system for 12+ industries in Nepal & South Asia (Retail POS, Wholesalers, Importers/Exporters, Manufacturing BOM/WIP, Healthcare, Academics, Petroleum, Automobile), featuring Accounting, IRD CBMS VAT sync, Inventory/Multi-Godown FIFO, Sales, Purchase, HR & Biometric Payroll, Loan/Cooperative, Fixed Assets, and Project BOQ modules.
